description: A PAGE IS OFTEN SEVERAL DOCUMENTS, AND THE INTERESTING ONE IS USUALLY NOT THE OUTER ONE. A payment form, an SSO step, a chat widget, a Stripe or 3-D Secure field: each lives in a frame of its own, and a frame from another domain cannot be read from the page around it — that is the same-origin rule and no amount of JavaScript gets past it. Qiksy now runs INSIDE every frame and answers about its own document, which is what makes them readable at all. This lists them: `frameId`, the address, the title, and how many controls each holds, with the page itself first. Pass the `frameId` you want to qa_read, qa_styles and the other reading verbs; leave it out and you get the page itself, never a frame picked at random. Call this the moment a control you can see on screen is missing from qa_snapshot: nine times out of ten it is not missing, it is in a frame nobody named. Read-only and free.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_frames
